name: swap-offer-offline
description: The offer envelope and the taker's first three gates, checked against the deltas the compiled circuit actually produced for both shapes
note: Offers are built for real in the keyless simulator and their MEASURED imbalances drive the gates. Every tamper — envelope bytes, declared terms, and artefact shapes no taker can settle — is refused offline, before a wallet, a proof server or a node is contacted.
